newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: AMP's Ergo cuts fixed and floating NZ home rates.
newsitem.headline: AMP's Ergo cuts fixed and floating NZ home rates.

text.p: AMP Society's telephone banking subsidiary Ergo said on Tuesday it was cutting its New Zealand floating home loan rate to 10.4 percent from 10.95 percent and its one-year fixed rate to 9.65 percent from 9.95 percent.
The rates take effect immediately for new business and from December 16 for existing customers.
Ergo's two and three-year fixed rates remain at 9.5 percent and its one-year capped rate at 10.5 percent.
Managing Director Graham Meyer said short-term wholesale rates had stayed relatively stable since a Reserve Bank statement on October 24 saying there was scope for rates to ease.
"Our lower cost structures see us well placed to drop interest rates further and still maintain a sensible margin over current funding costs," he said.
